newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates unchanged to slightly up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates unchanged to slightly up.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted steady to higher on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Monday.
- Two barges, upper Mississippi (St Paul-Savage), one each week of July 20 and 27, bid 135 percent of tariff - unchanged, no offer.
- Four barges, Illinois River, two each week of July 20 and 27, bid 100 percent, one barge per week offered 105, no comparison on either value.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week of August, bid 117-1/2 percent - up 2-1/2 points, offered 125 - unchanged.
- Three barges, Mississippi (McGregor and south), one each week from August 17 to 31, bid 135 percent, offered 151 - no comparison on either value.
- Four barges, mid Mississippi, two each week of September 21 and 28, bid at 205 percent - up 2-1/2 points, offered 220 - unchanged.
- Four to eight barges, Mississippi (Osceola through Cairo), October, one barge per week bid 195 percent - no comparison, two barges per week offered at 205- unchanged.
